caption: Type 3r
note: r waits for a letter, and the status line shows the count and r.

caption: Type x
note: Three letters become x, and the cursor is on the last one.

caption: Press j, 0, then .
note: . repeats r with its letter and count, over a tab too.

caption: Press u
note: One undo brings the three letters back, with the cursor on the first.

caption: Press V, then r and -
note: V-LINE: every letter of the line becomes -, and the mode returns to NORMAL.

caption: Press j, l, Ctrl-V, j, l, then r and *
note: V-BLOCK: the block's columns become *. The short last line is replaced to its end.

caption: Press v, l, then r and Enter
note: r then Enter over VISUAL does nothing and keeps the selection.

caption: Press gg, then r and Enter
note: In NORMAL, r then Enter breaks the line at the letter.
